tasks.title: Fix OvertimeService::staffOptions() so the edit form always includes the overtime's current staff (Laravel app, this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Bug (verified against live DB): overtime #2527 has staff_id=64 (Mohd Afiq Bin Mohd Zawawi) but that staff's `active` column is 0 (deactivated), so `OvertimeService::staffOptions()` - which filters `Staff::where('active', 1)` - does not include id 64, the edit blade resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/overtime/edit.blade.php has no `<option value="64">`, and the staff select shows the placeholder instead of the staff name. Fix in TWO files, minimal edits: (1) app/Services/HumanResources/OvertimeService.php - change the method signature `public function staffOptions(): array` to `public function staffOptions(?int $includeStaffId = null): array` and at the END of the method, after the existing mapWithKeys->toArray() result is built into `$options` (adjust the code so the existing return value is assigned to a variable first), add: `if ($includeStaffId && !isset($options[$includeStaffId])) { $s = App\Models\Staff::find($includeStaffId); if ($s) { $username = $s->hasmanylogin()->where('active', 1)->first()?->username; $options[$includeStaffId] = ($username ?? '') . ' - ' . $s->name; } }` then `return $options;` - do NOT change any other method and do NOT remove the active filter (new selections must stay limited to active staff; only the currently-assigned staff is force-included). (2) app/Http/Controllers/HumanResources/HRDept/OvertimeController.php - in the edit() method change `'staffs' => $service->staffOptions(),` to `'staffs' => $service->staffOptions($overtime->staff_id),`. Verify: `php -l` on both files reports No syntax errors; `php artisan tinker --execute="echo json_encode([(new App\Services\HumanResources\OvertimeService())->staffOptions(64)[64] ?? null]);"` must print the staff label (not null); and `php artisan view:cache` succeeds. Report the php -l results, the tinker output, and the exact lines changed.

Test the overtime edit staff fix (Laravel app, this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Verify: (1) `php -l` on app/Services/HumanResources/OvertimeService.php and app/Http/Controllers/HumanResources/HRDept/OvertimeController.php - No syntax errors; (2) `php artisan tinker --execute="$o = App\Models\HumanResources\HROvertime::find(2527); $opts = (new App\Services\HumanResources\OvertimeService())->staffOptions($o->staff_id); echo $o->staff_id.':' . (isset($opts[$o->staff_id]) ? 'INCLUDED' : 'MISSING') . PHP_EOL;"` must print INCLUDED for staff 64; (3) render the edit view with a real auth user to prove the option is selected: `php artisan tinker --execute="$admin = App\Models\Login::whereIn('staff_id', [117,72])->where('active',1)->first(); Auth::login($admin); $o = App\Models\HumanResources\HROvertime::find(2527); $html = view('humanresources.hrdept.overtime.edit', ['overtime' => $o, 'staffs' => (new App\Services\HumanResources\OvertimeService())->staffOptions($o->staff_id), 'overtimeRanges' => (new App\Services\HumanResources\OvertimeService())->overtimeRangeOptions()])->render(); echo strpos($html, 'value="64" selected') !== false ? 'SELECTED OK' : 'NOT SELECTED'; echo PHP_EOL;"` must print SELECTED OK; (4) `php artisan test` full suite passes (report count; do not fix unrelated failures). Report each step's output and your verdict.

tasks.title: Document the overtime edit staff fix (this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Append a short section to docs/changelog/2026-08-17-leave-approval-api-datatable.md OR create docs/changelog/2026-08-17-overtime-edit-staff-fix.md (prefer the existing changelog file for today): one paragraph - overtime edit form (/overtime/{id}/edit) showed the placeholder instead of the staff name when the assigned staff had been deactivated (active=0); root cause: OvertimeService::staffOptions() filtered Staff::where('active',1) so the current staff id was absent from the dropdown; fix: staffOptions(?int $includeStaffId = null) force-includes the overtime's current staff in the options and OvertimeController::edit() passes $overtime->staff_id. Include the verification result (staff 64 INCLUDED, SELECTED OK, php artisan test count from the tester's report). Do not invent details. Report the file edited and a one-line summary.
